lines.t: The ground shakes when Your light breaks through,
Every shadow runs when You move.
I hear Your voice in the fire and rain—
A thunder calling out my name.
You tear the chains that I couldn’t see,
You breathe power, awakening me.
No force can stand, no fear can rise,
When Your glory fractures the skies.
You’re the fire in my lungs,
The pulse inside my veins,
The strength when I can’t stand—
YahuShua, You remain.
Raise me up, break me open,
Let the darkness flee…
’Cause when You speak one word—
Every wall breaks free!
Every wall breaks free!
LIGHT BREAKS — CHAINS FALL — YOU REIGN — STAND TALL
YAHUSHUA! YAHUSHUA!
(chopped / repeated / distorted)
VERSE 2
Storms rise, but You tell them “Be still.”
Your peace hits harder than any will.
You turn my weakness into flame,
Your power written in my frame.
When everything shakes, I stand in You—
My fortress, faithful, strong, and true.
Your love is louder than the night,
A roar of everlasting light.
Take this heart and make it burn,
Turn the ashes into gold.
Let the nations feel the power
Of the One who holds my soul.
Lift me higher, break me open,
Let the darkness flee…
’Cause when You speak one word—
Every chain breaks FREE!
Your name is the fire,
The spark in my bones—
YahuShua, my Savior,
Forever on the throne.
